title: Peer-Support-Angebote im Zusammenhang mit Health Literacy bei Brustkrebspatientinnen
author: Elisabeth Parzefall

steps.title: Define Research Question and Criteria
steps.instruction: Establish the research framework using the PCC (Population – Concept – Context) framework according to the JBI Manual for Evidence Synthesis.

substeps.instruction: Define the primary research question: 'Which evidence on the relationships between peer support offers and health literacy in adult breast cancer patients is available?'

Develop sub-questions regarding health literacy aspects, peer support characteristics (format, duration, frequency, setting), patient characteristics (age, menopause status, cancer stage, treatment status), and research gaps/recommendations.
Define inclusion and exclusion criteria based on the PCC framework.

steps.title: Conduct Three-Stage Literature Search
steps.instruction: Perform a comprehensive search for German and English language literature without time restrictions using JBI recommendations.

substeps.instruction: Step 1: Conduct an initial limited search in MEDLINE and CINAHL to identify key terms and synonyms in titles, abstracts, and keywords.
Step 2: Execute a systematic search across MEDLINE (via PubMed), CINAHL (via EBSCOhost), PsycINFO (via Ovid), LIVIVO, and Web of Science using the refined search terms.

Step 3: Perform a manual search, including forward and backward citation tracking of included full texts and searching for grey literature (e.g., cancer organization reports, self-help association publications, unpublished Bachelor/Master theses).

steps.title: Manage and Screen Literature
steps.instruction: Organize identified citations and retrieve full texts for evaluation.

substeps.instruction: Import all identified citations into the Rayyan web-based screening tool.
Procure full texts via library access; if unavailable, contact authors directly. Exclude studies if the full text cannot be obtained.

steps.title: Extract Data from Included Studies
steps.instruction: Systematically extract relevant information using a Microsoft Excel data extraction form, performed by two independent reviewers (EP and LH).

substeps.instruction: Pilot the extraction form using a subset of 2-3 studies to verify applicability and completeness, adjusting the form if necessary.

Extract the following data points: 1. Authors, 2. Year of publication, 3. Country of origin/publication, 4. Study objective/purpose, 5. Population characteristics (e.g., age, cancer stage) and sample size, 6. Type and duration of peer support, 7. Investigated aspects of health literacy, 8. Methodology and methods used, 9. Central results regarding the research question.

steps.title: Analyze and Report Results
steps.instruction: Evaluate extracted data descriptively and report findings according to PRISMA-ScR guidelines.

substeps.instruction: Perform thematic categorization of health literacy aspects and peer support characteristics.
Summarize population, disease, and treatment characteristics of included patients.
Create Table 1: Overview of study characteristics (authors, year, country, design, population, context, peer support features).
Create Table 2: Content results (health literacy aspects, reported effects/relationships, recommendations, and research gaps).
Provide a narrative summary and, if appropriate, graphical representations of results.
Document the selection process using a PRISMA flow diagram, detailing the number of sources identified, screened, excluded (with reasons), and included.

description: Das Titel-/Abstract-Screening sowie das Volltextscreening werden durch zwei unabhängige Reviewerinnen durchgeführt. Die Auswahl erfolgt anhand der definierten Einschlusskriterien. Diskrepanzen zwischen den Reviewerinnen (EP und LH) werden zunächst durch Diskussion und dann durch das Hinzuziehen der betreuenden Person (PR) gelöst.
